**Summary**


Resideo introduced the First Alert® CX6T Advanced AI Turret Camera and Resideo One portal at its annual CONNECT customer event designed to make enterprise-grade intelligence accessible to small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Powered by Resideo Pro-IQ™ services, the solutions combine AI video intelligence, live 4K video, intelligent event detection, natural-language video search and multi-site security management to help businesses monitor their properties and respond to security events quickly.


# Resideo Expands AI-Powered Security Portfolio with New Camera and Software Portal


## First Alert® CX6T Advanced AI Camera and Resideo One portal combine intelligent video monitoring, AI-powered insights and connected services for small businesses


[Company News](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/corporate/newsroom/all-articles/#f:tags=[Company%20News])


[Security](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/corporate/newsroom/all-articles/#f:tags=[Security])


11/19/26


**SCOTTSDALE, Ariz.** , (Nov. 19, 2026) –[Resideo Technologies](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/resideo-home/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) (NYSE: REZI), a leading global provider of solutions for home comfort, security and safety, today introduced new AI-powered security solutions at its annual CONNECT Customer Event. Powered by Resideo’s Pro-IQ™ services, the[First Alert® CX6T Advanced AI Turret Camera](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/cx6t-camera/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) and[Resideo One portal](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-one-security/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) support Resideo’s broader strategy to deliver differentiated solutions while creating new software and services opportunities for its professional partners.


"This is a defining evolution of Resideo's security offering as we’re integrating advanced video cameras with intelligent video management and services into one seamless and reliable offering,” said Pat Tessier, Vice President of Product Development at Resideo. "Resideo is applying AI across the security experience, from detecting activity at the edge and finding events with natural language to turning video intelligence into actionable alerts, creating a more powerful connected security experience for users and new opportunities for our professional dealers.”


The new AI-powered capabilities expand Resideo’s connected security offering beyond standalone devices into an integrated portfolio of solutions, software and services designed to make enterprise-grade intelligence accessible to small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs).


## Advanced Solutions for Growing Businesses


The[CX6T camera](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/cx6t-camera/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) and[Resideo One portal](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-one-security/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) combine AI video intelligence, live 4K video, intelligent event detection, natural-language video search and multi-site security management to help businesses monitor their properties and respond to security events quickly.


“Small businesses deserve access to the same intelligent video capabilities as larger enterprises, without the enterprise-level complexity or cost,” said Tessier. “Resideo is combining advanced camera technology with our hybrid edge-and-cloud-based AI to deliver powerful, actionable insights at a price point designed for small businesses or larger homes.”


For SMBs operating across multiple storefronts, offices or commercial properties, the CX6T camera and Resideo One portal together provide unified camera visibility across locations and help businesses:


- **See clearly, day or night** . The CX6T delivers clear, detailed recordings even in challenging lighting conditions with 8MP ultra-high-resolution recorded video, live 4K video and superior low-light image quality and color retention, while high dynamic range (HDR) and AI-enhanced image processing help reduce grain, glare and motion blur.
- **Know when activity needs attention.** Edge-based AI analytics help identify relevant security events while filtering out unnecessary alerts, with critical sound detection for smoke alarms, car alarms, breaking glass and screams.
- **Find and review important moments quickly.** AI-powered semantic search enables users to locate video events in the app or portal using natural language, while hybrid storage combines continuous on-camera recording with cloud-based event clips for easy review, verification and sharing of important recordings.
- **Respond remotely and deter unwanted activity.** A built-in microphone and speaker enable two-way audio through the[Resideo Connect app](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-connect-app/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) and the[Resideo One portal](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-one-security/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) , while multi-color deterrence lights and a security siren help users respond to suspicious activity.
- **Add visibility where it’s needed.** A wide-angle lens expands coverage and camera-placement flexibility. For retrofits and upgrades, the CX6T is ONVIF-compliant* and supports integration with compatible existing video management systems.


The[Resideo One portal](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-one-security/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) brings these capabilities together through a centralized web experience giving security professionals and small businesses a single place to view and manage systems across multiple locations, review events and turn system information into actionable intelligence. With Pro-IQ Secure and Pro-IQ Protect services, security customers can benefit from ongoing intrusion and video services, intelligent analytics and cloud storage, creating new opportunities as customer needs evolve.


## Availability


Together, the CX6T, Resideo One and Pro-IQ services reflect Resideo's strategy to combine connected devices with software, AI and services to create differentiated experiences for customers and new opportunities for its professional partners. In the coming months, the[First Alert CX6T Advanced AI Camera](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/cx6t-camera/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) will be available through security distributors in the U.S. and Canada, and portal features and Pro-IQ services will be introduced. Advanced video features and connected services may require a service subscription.


# # #


## About Resideo


Resideo is a global building technologies company that is a leading developer and manufacturer of critical control and sensing solutions for residential markets. The company serves professional installers and integrators across diverse product categories, such as heating, ventilation and air conditioning controls, combustion, life safety, security and water. Its comfort and protection solutions can be found in more than 150 million residential and commercial spaces globally, with tens of millions of new devices sold annually. More information about Resideo and its trusted brands, including BRK, First Alert and Honeywell Home, is available at[Resideo.com](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/resideo-home/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement)


.


**ONVIF-conformant model not compatible with Pro-IQ services.*


The CX6T camera delivers superior low-light image quality and color retention to capture clear recordings in challenging lighting conditions. Built-in multi-color deterrence lights, a security siren and a passive nighttime blue light help discourage suspicious activity, day or night.


A wide-angle lens helps monitor large areas, giving dealers flexibility to position cameras where visibility matters most.


Designed for efficient installation, the CX6T camera offers plug-and-play configuration and camera auto-discovery that help security professionals streamline setup and reduce time on-site.


Remote troubleshooting, system health monitoring and remote user firmware updates help streamline ongoing service and reduce the need for on-site visits.


The[Resideo One portal](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-one-security/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) offers security professionals and small businesses a single place to view and manage systems across multiple locations, review events and turn system information into actionable intelligence.


## Frequently Asked Questions


**What is the key takeaway from this new product introduction for security dealers?**


This is more than a new product introduction. For security dealers, it's a step change. Resideo is


making more products available on its modern portal that combines the reliability customers expect with smarter tools that make installations easier, simplify account management, and create a better experience for their customers.


- The new software platform provides a centralized experience for managing connected security capabilities, and includes the Resideo Technician app, Resideo Connect end-user app and Resideo One portal.
- The CX6T camera enables businesses and security professionals to view cameras across locations, review video events and access intelligent video capabilities.
- With Pro-IQ Secure and Pro-IQ Protect services, security customers can benefit from ongoing intrusion and video services, intelligent analytics and cloud storage, creating new opportunities as their needs evolve.


**What is the First Alert CX6T Advanced AI Camera?**


[The First Alert CX6T Advanced AI Camera](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/cx6t-camera/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) is a video security camera for small and medium-sized businesses that combines live 4K video, AI-powered event detection, critical sound detection, deterrence features and intelligent video search.


**How does the First Alert CX6T use AI?**


The CX6T uses edge-based AI analytics to identify relevant security events and filter unnecessary alerts. When paired with the Resideo One portal, AI-powered semantic search also allows users to find video events using natural-language descriptions.


**What applications is the First Alert CX6T Advanced AI Camera designed for?**


The First Alert CX6T is designed for small and medium-sized businesses, light-commercial applications and select premium residential properties that want enterprise-grade video capabilities in a solution suited to their security needs.


**What are design advantages of the Resideo One portal?**


Built on a cloud-based architecture, the Resideo One portal is designed to maintain availability if one part of the infrastructure experiences an issue. It offers dealers a fast, reliable experience that simplifies operations, while giving them a foundation that can evolve as their business and the security industry evolves.


**What benefits do Resideo's software products offer security dealers?**


Resideo’s software products help security dealers streamline workflows, simplify system management and stay connected with customers to support long-term value.


- [Resideo Technician app](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/proapp-download/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) : Simplifies device setup and programming, helping support a more efficient in-field technician experience.
- [Resideo One portal](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-one-security/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) : A single portal to deploy, manage and scale customer systems. Security dealers can configure systems before arriving on-site and access tools for account testing, zone synchronization and emergency contact management, helping simplify workflows and reduce time spent managing individual systems.
- [Resideo Connect app](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-connect-app/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cx6t_resideo_one_announcement) : An end-user app that brings intrusion and video together with Resideo’s breadth of connected products, including smart thermostats and water leak detectors. The app helps keep security dealers connected with their customers by displaying security dealer contact information in the app and giving dealers the ability to provide links to support and send customized messages.
